newsitem.title: GERMANY: DB to start Frankfurt airport rail freight feeder.
newsitem.headline: DB to start Frankfurt airport rail freight feeder.

text.p: Airfreight rail feeder services to and from Frankfurt airport's Cargo City South terminal will start later this summer, German railways Deutsche Bahn (DB) said.
DB Cargo will operate daily services between Hamburg and Osnabrueck in northern Germany and Frankfurt airport with four of its new CargoSprinter trains, a statement said.
German forwarders Gebrueder Hellmann GmbH and Johann Birkart GmbH have signed deals to transport containers amounting to the equivalent of 5,000 truckloads a year on the new service, it added.
The CargoSprinter units, capable of carrying a maximum of 160 tonnes and reaching up to 120km/h, will meet and split on route at Hanover.
Lufthansa Cargo and Swissair are planning to launch similar air cargo rail feeder services using the CargoSprinter between Frankfurt and Zurich airports this autumn.
